spec.hypothesis: H2: exposed DPGs lost team members after the 2025 US funding freeze; output fell less than team size
spec.sample: analysis_sample.in_joint_test == True (B1-B3 and repo confidence high); sensitivity: in_joint_test_sens
spec.exposure: funding_flags.exposed (score 2 or 3, DESIGN B); dose-response with funding_flags.exposure_score
spec.model: OLS on log1p outcomes with DPG and quarter fixed effects, exposed x quarter coefficients, SE clustered by DPG (CR1)
spec.elasticity: log output on log team size is descriptive; output per person is never a primary outcome
checks: pre-trend: joint test that exposed x quarter coefficients before the reference quarter are zero
placebo group: exposure_score == 1 (federal money, not foreign aid) vs score 0
placebo date: fake shock at 2023-01-20 using 2022Q1-2023Q4
robustness: restrict controls to the same owner_type as exposed
spec.power: D23: MDE ~= 2.8 * sd_between_dpg_change_in_pre_period * sqrt(1/n_exposed + 1/n_unexposed); computed from pre-period data only
